auth.method: OAuth 2.0 account connection; Provider connection fields

operations.description: Fetch a form's full structure: title, settings, items with their indices and itemIds, question IDs, and current revisionId.

inputs.description: The ID of the form to fetch. Obtain it from forms_create_form, forms_list_responses, or the New Response trigger.
inputs.label: Form ID
inputs.name: form_id

operations.name: Get Form

operations.description: Fetch one submission by its responseId, including all answers keyed by questionId and submission timestamps.

inputs.description: The ID of the form the response belongs to. Obtain it from forms_list_responses or the New Response trigger.
inputs.label: Form ID
inputs.name: form_id

inputs.description: The ID of the response to fetch. Obtain it from forms_list_responses or the New Response trigger.
inputs.label: Response ID
inputs.name: response_id

operations.name: Get Form Response

operations.description: List submitted responses for a form, with each response's responseId, timestamps, and answers keyed by questionId.

inputs.description: The ID of the form whose responses to list. Obtain it from forms_create_form, forms_get_form, or the New Response trigger.
inputs.label: Form ID
inputs.name: form_id

inputs.description: Optional filter on submission time, e.g. "timestamp > 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" or "timestamp < 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z". Only the timestamp field is supported.
inputs.label: Filter
inputs.name: filter

inputs.description: Maximum number of responses to return per page (default 5000).
inputs.label: Page Size
inputs.name: page_size

inputs.description: Token from a previous call's nextPageToken to fetch the next page of responses.
inputs.label: Page Token
inputs.name: page_token

operations.name: List Form Responses

operations.description: Triggers when someone submits a response to the form. Can also trigger when a respondent edits their response.

inputs.label: Run_On
inputs.name: run_on
inputs.source_expression: Property.StaticDropdown<string>({ displayName: 'Run On', description: 'Choose whether an edited response starts the flow again.', required: false, defaultValue: RUN_ON_NEW_ONLY, options: { disabled: false, options: [ { label: 'New responses only', value: RUN_ON_NEW_ONLY }, { label: 'New and edited responses', value: RUN_ON_NEW_AND_EDITED }, ], }, })

operations.name: New Response
